content: Borkum Riff is a brand of pipe tobacco that is manufactured in Denmark by Swedish Match. It is one of the most popular pipe tobacco brands globally and was first introduced in 1968. During the Age of Discovery, Swedish explorers arrived in North America in 1638, establishing a colony in Delaware. They began trading with the local inhabitants, exchanging Swedish goods for items such as furs. Among these traded goods, tobacco quickly gained popularity in Europe. Recognizing its potential, Queen Kristina of Sweden appointed skilled craftsmen to refine the production of high-quality pipe tobacco, catering to European nobility. This tradition of excellence has been preserved by Borkum Riff, which has earned a distinguished reputation among pipe tobacco connoisseurs worldwide. The origins of Borkum Riff as a tobacco brand date back to the early 1960s when it was launched in Sweden. Before this, the name Borkum Riff was associated with a lighthouse located in the Helgoland Bay off the Dutch coast in the North Sea. This lighthouse was a well-known landmark for sailors and frequently mentioned in Swedish weather reports. The initial tobacco blend introduced under the Borkum Riff name was a rough-cut mixture of Virginia and Burley tobaccos. Although it had a slow start, sales gradually increased, and the addition of a whiskey flavor significantly boosted its popularity. Today, Borkum Riff is the third-largest pipe tobacco brand in Sweden, following Greve Hamilton and Caravelle. In 1968, a pivotal moment occurred in Borkum Riff's history when Swedish Tobacco Co. blenders developed a new pipe tobacco formula with unique smoking characteristics. This blend was soft, rich, and mellow, with a taste that did not irritate the mouth. It was easy to handle, stayed lit well, and offered a light flavor with sufficient strength to provide a pleasant aroma. This tobacco became an ideal choice for individuals transitioning from cigarette smoking to pipe smoking and achieved immediate global success. The packaging of Borkum Riff was designed to reflect its high-quality image. The pouch design, already established in Sweden, was chosen for its simplicity and timeless appeal. The ship featured in the design originates from a 17th-century engraving by Johann Baptista Homann, a German cartographer. In 1969, Borkum Riff introduced its Bourbon Whiskey blend to the U.S. market, where it achieved significant success. Early feedback from wholesalers, retailers, and consumers was overwhelmingly positive, with many stating that it was the pipe tobacco U.S. smokers had been waiting for. Since then, new flavors and packaging formats have been introduced, and Borkum Riff has expanded to markets in Canada, Australia, Switzerland, Spain, New Zealand, Japan, France, Italy, Germany, and many other countries. The United States remains its largest market. As of 2007, Borkum Riff offers a variety of products, including: Borkum Riff Original Borkum Riff Bourbon Whiskey Borkum Riff Cherry Liqueur Borkum Riff Scandinavian Mixture Borkum Riff Orange & Honey Borkum Riff Cherry Cavendish Borkum Riff Black Cavendish Borkum Riff Vanilla Cavendish Borkum Riff Champagne Borkum Riff Highland Malt Whiskey Borkum Riff Special Mixture No. Borkum Riff is undoubtedly one of the most successful tobacco brands in the world today.
